1. **PR #6651 (TRUNK-6818), merged 2026-10-05.** "Context.closeSession() closes sessions it did not open." It removed `private final ThreadLocal<Integer> participationDepth = ThreadLocal.withInitial(() -> 0);` from `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateContextDAO.java` (removed line 320).
2. **PR #6588 (TRUNK-6721), merged 2026-09-21.** "Replace StackWalker with a thread-local guard in UserDAO." It added `private static final ThreadLocal<Integer> DEPTH = new ThreadLocal<>();` to `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/impl/UserServiceImpl.java` (added line 108).
3. **PR #6598 (TRUNK-6707), merged 2026-10-01.** "Implement full caching for Global Properties." It removed `ThreadLocal<Boolean> participate` (line 318) and added `ThreadLocal<Integer> participationDepth` (line 320) in `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateContextDAO.java`.
4. **PR #6544 (TRUNK-6799), merged 2026-10-08.** "Introduce Spring Security with support for legacy authentication context." In `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/context/Context.java` it removed the Object-array `userContextHolder` ThreadLocal (line 145) and the comment about it (line 143), added a typed `ThreadLocal<UserContext> userContextHolder` (line 160), and changed the Javadoc mentions of ThreadLocal (lines 228, 233).

Matches outside that path were excluded. These are in `api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/security/` (PRs #6674 and #6668), `api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/util/UuidUtil.java` (PR for TRUNK-6733, #6391), and `api/src/test/java/org/openmrs/api/cache/RolePrivilegeCacheLoadTest.java` (PR #6627), which is under the test tree rather than the main `org/openmrs/api` tree.
